data.title: 法琳 · 汤还要再凉一会儿
data.description: 旅店厨房的小锅刚离火。法琳舀起一勺蔬菜汤轻轻吹气，另一只手把碗端稳，等温度合适才请你尝。
data.promptProse: In a rustic inn kitchen, Falin wears an oatmeal linen dress and terracotta apron. She supports a bowl of vegetable soup and gently blows across a spoonful to cool it. The small cooking pot rests off the fire; warm hearth light reaches her face and the bread on the counter.
data.animaCaption: One hand steadies the bowl while the other holds the spoon just below her lips.
data.action: 端稳汤碗，吹凉勺中的蔬菜汤
